desktopBaseline.check: W04 typed Watch History. Durable Stream, Video, and Clip rows with thumbnails, avatars, timestamps, progress, Resume after Start, Replay at 0, local search, and offline reads. Reopening never autoplays.

candidate.provenance: API 30 development client. Metro JS loaded from the W04 worktree. Product Store schema v4. Guest signed-out reads stay { kind: "guest" }. Capture path is Channel Detail then Watch.

observations: Mobile unit tests, feature architecture, and persistence tests passed on this tree, including schema v4 History rows and the newer-than-supported schema rejection.
More History started empty with local-only copy and a Search history dock.
Guest Search opened Twitch xQc Channel Detail. A completed Videos row played after Start watching.
History then showed a VIDEO TWITCH row with 16:9 thumb, avatar, timestamp, and recorded actions.
Resume and Replay both landed on Start watching. The session did not autoplay.
Remove and Clear asked first. Cancel kept the row.
force-stop plus relaunch still listed the same History VIDEO row.
With wifi and data disabled, History still listed the saved VIDEO row.
Schema v4 adds thumbnail, avatar, channel, and duration columns on history_items.
Persistence tests reject PRAGMA user_version newer than the supported schema.
